top_signals.title: Pakistan Army Chief Heads to Iran to Boost Mideast Peace Efforts
top_signals.summary: Pakistan’s Army Chief Field Marshal Asim Munir is traveling to Iran as part of efforts to end the Middle East conflict as tensions rise between Tehran and Washington.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Philippine Corporate Regulator Targets Stock Brokers in Next Reform Push
top_signals.summary: The Philippines’ corporate regulator is looking to increase the minimum capital requirement for stock brokers as it forges ahead with reforms despite pushback from some market participants.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
